correctness.rationale: The leave-one-out mean and residual give the stated endpoints exactly. For a candidate \(y\), direct subtraction of squared residuals factors as \(((n+1)d_i-x)^2-n^2x^2=(n+1)(n-1)(d_i-x)(x+c_nd_i)\), so each comparison is exactly membership in \([\ell_i,u_i]\). The source quantile index requires at least \(j=\lfloor\alpha(n+1)\rfloor\) such intervals, all of which contain \(\bar Y\); the resulting depth set is exactly \([\ell_{(j)},u_{(k)}]\). Exact-arithmetic replay independently evaluates the original residual definitions on all breakpoint cells for several rational samples and checks the edge convention and rank-count consequence.

value.rationale: The sample mean is a canonical location predictor, and the direct source emphasizes a generic gap between jackknife+ and full conformal in both coverage guarantee and computation. Showing that the two methods collapse to the identical finite-sample set in this natural model explains exact nominal-grid coverage rather than only empirical near-coverage, and isolates a concrete structural mechanism: all candidate residual comparisons become intervals sharing one center. This is a reusable boundary case for analyzing when jackknife+ can inherit full-conformal validity, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a recomputation of a known table.
